$comment: The foreign-object catalogue. This is DATA, shared by two consumers: the game (src/game/catalog.ts) and the asset generator (tools/generate-assets.mjs). `prompt` is sent verbatim to Aholo Lux3D text-to-3D; `height` is the metres the loaded model is normalised to, because generation output has no canonical scale. `weirdness` 3 entries are the horror pool used by the 'stare' anomaly. faceCount is the Lux3D triangle budget: omitting it lets the API use its 300k maximum, which is ~16 MB per asset.
